newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar futures close with modest gains.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar futures close with modest gains.

text.p: White sugar futures extended earlier gains by the close although the lack of momentum behind the market meant that rises were modest.
Front month August finished at $321.90 up $0.70 reversing earlier light losses and October was off its high at $315.60, a gain of $0.90.
August traded 2,655 lots and October 1,155 contracts to dominate the activity.
In Paris the principal contracts both ended just off their highs with August ending up $2.50 at $324.00 and October was $1.00 ahead at $315.50.
